summary: Repaired /srv/inventory on node1: created system group inventory-readers and system user inventorysvc, recursively chowned the tree to inventorysvc:inventory-readers, and set mode 750 on directories / 640 on files (owner rw, group r, no access for others). Original data (records.csv, config.json) preserved byte-for-byte. Completed mandatory single-node restart evidence protocol: captured healthy baseline (boot_id + permissions + data), rebooted node1 natively, confirmed connection loss during reboot, polled until reachable again, verified boot_id changed, and re-verified ownership/permissions/data intact post-restart.
actions_performed: Inspected existing /srv/inventory tree, ownership, and absence of inventorysvc user / inventory-readers group
Created system user inventorysvc (system account, nologin shell, own private group)
Set directories to 750 and files to 640 recursively under /srv/inventory
Verified final ownership/permissions and confirmed file contents unchanged
Captured pre-restart boot_id and health baseline for node1
Triggered native reboot on node1 via backgrounded `reboot` so the ack returned before disconnection
Polled node1 until exec succeeded again, confirming connection loss then recovery
Verified boot_id changed post-restart, proving an actual reboot occurred
Re-verified /srv/inventory ownership, permissions, and data contents post-restart

evidence.requirement: Existing data ownership/permissions state before repair (baseline)
evidence.summary: Showed /srv/inventory owned by root:root with world-readable perms, and confirmed no inventorysvc user or inventory-readers group existed yet
Created inventory-readers group and inventorysvc system user, confirmed via id/getent

evidence.requirement: Data owned by inventorysvc, readable by inventory-readers, inaccessible to others
evidence.summary: chown -R to inventorysvc:inventory-readers and chmod 750 dirs / 640 files applied; ls -ld shows drwxr-x--- / -rw-r----- with no other-user access
records.csv and config.json content matches original inspection, unchanged after ownership/permission repair

evidence.requirement: Node1 healthy baseline before restart (boot id + service/data health)
evidence.summary: Captured boot_id e31962a9-8d32-4c19-8dd2-0b96a45c6c48 plus healthy /srv/inventory ownership/permissions and user/group existence prior to reboot

evidence.requirement: Node1 restart acknowledgement returned before disconnection
evidence.summary: Backgrounded `reboot` command via nohup/disown returned 'reboot scheduled' immediately, before the node went down

evidence.requirement: Node1 disconnected during restart and boot identity changed
evidence.summary: Connection reset then timed out confirming the node was down mid-reboot; subsequent successful exec shows boot_id 9851f050-280c-42ac-9d25-975873b79263, different from baseline, proving an actual reboot occurred

evidence.requirement: Node1 post-restart recovery of required data/permissions/accounts
evidence.summary: Post-restart check shows /srv/inventory still owned by inventorysvc:inventory-readers with 750/640 modes, file contents identical, and inventorysvc user / inventory-readers group still present
